full_text: Any local official and any person or persons dealing with him who violate the prohibitions provided in Section 89 of Book I hereof, shall be punished with imprisonment for six months and one day to six years, or a fine of not less than Three thousand pesos (P=3,000.00) nor more than Ten thousand pesos (P=10,000.00), or both such imprisonment and fine, at the discretion of the court.
